jewel.line: Who gave to me a jewel
stanza: The seventh and longest song on Joanna Newsom’s fourth LP, Divers. This song, l…
(And I am his, if I am not deceived)
Who takes one breath above, for every hour below the sea;
Who gave to me a jewel
Worth twice this woman's life (but would cost her less
Than laying at low tide
To see her true love phosphoresce)
The jewel of Africa, jewel
What good is a jewel that ain't still precious?
How could you run off on me? How could you run off on us?
You feel like God inside that gold
I found you laying down with Samson and his full head of hair
I found my black queen, Cleopatra, bad dreams, Cleopatra
